name: api-gateway
description: API Gateway for Corporate Chat microservices

scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others --restart-tries 3 --names "API-GW,AUTH,USER-MGT,MEDIA,CHAT" --colors "cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue" "nodemon --config nodemon-all.json --exec \"tsc && node dist/server.js\" --watch src --ext ts" "cd ../auth-service && nodemon --exec \"npm run dev\"" "cd ../user-management-service && nodemon --exec \"npm run dev\"" "cd ../media-service && nodemon --exec \"npm run dev\"" "cd ../chat-service && nodemon --exec \"npm run dev\""
